notes.title: Prisoner - Release Build #71327
notes.notes:
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Improved graphic quality at all levels
	[*]All in-game sounds have been normalized
	[*]Start room has been rebuilt
	[*]Added some DLC sprites at start room
	[*]Special application branch is no longer supported
[/list]
[h1]Traps[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Fixed light sources at some traps
	[*]Fixed animations at laser traps
[/list]
[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Fixed character physics
	[*]Fixed character movement animation
	[*]Fixed error at "Trial of Darkness" walkthrough
	[*]Fixed incorrect UI display at "Trial of Death" walkthrough
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Settings: Maximum brightness has been increased from 0.1 to 0.3
	[*]Character: Jump height has been increased by 0.05
[/list]

notes.title: Prisoner - Pre-release Build #47426
notes.notes:
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Added "Color profiles" to settings menu, which contain 7 new color profiles
	[*]Added additional dialog to main menu
[/list]
[h1]Rooms[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Changed traps positions at most levels
	[*]Changed light sources positions at some levels
	[*]Removed decorative objects at some levels
[/list]
[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Fixed rare crash at level 4-7
	[*]Fixed "flame star" range of damage
	[*]Fixed bug with endless footsteps sound
	[*]Fixed incorrect trap types at some levels
	[*]"Save & exit" button now correctly saves player's data after changes on settings menu
[/list]

notes.title: Prisoner - Pre-release Build #46875
notes.notes:
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Added short training at first game launch
	[*]Added color correction to all levels
	[*]Changed sign of player death
	[*]Default jump mode changed to "Low jump"
	[*]Changed some teleports positions
[/list]
[h1]Traps[/h1]
[list]
	[*][b]Steel[/b]

		[*]Bear trap: timing reduced from 0,33 to 0,125 sec
		[*]Fan (1 blade): timing increased from 0,66 to 0,75 sec
	
	[*][b]Electro[/b]

		[*]Single lightning: timing increased from 0,5 to 0,66 sec
		[*]Electric pillars: timing increased from 0,5 to 0,66 sec
		[*]Wandering lightning: timing increased from 0,8 to 1,16 sec
		[*]Electric sphere: timing increased from 0,8 to 1,16 sec
		[*]Lightning wall: timing increased from 0,5 to 0,8
	
	[*][b]Tech[/b]

		[*]Energy crystal: timing increased from 0,58 to 0,66
		[*]Energy cores: timing increased from 0,33 to 0,5
		[*]Transmitter: timing increased from 0,5 to 0,66
		[*]Scanner: timing increased from 1,5 to 2 sec
[/list]
[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Fixed rare bug with Steam API
[/list]
